name: @rivi-software/agentic-seo-check
stderr:
Usage: agentic-seo-check [options] [command]

SEO and AEO analysis for coding agents. Audits URLs, static build output or raw
HTML for search engines (audit, crawl) and AI answer engines (aeo), and prints
machine-readable findings.

Options:
  -V, --version              output the version number
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  audit [options] <target>   Audit a page, a site (--crawl), a build directory
                             or raw HTML
  crawl [options] <url>      Crawl a site and audit every page (same as "audit
                             --crawl")
  aeo [options] <target>     Answer engine optimization audit: AI crawler access
                             (robots.txt, llms.txt), snippet and AI opt-outs,
                             answer-ready content, entities and freshness, with
                             its own score
  rules [options]            List the rules this tool can report
  install-browser [options]  Download the Chromium build the installed
                             Playwright expects, for --render and --lighthouse
                             on a machine without Google Chrome
  mcp                        Start the MCP server on stdio (for Claude Code,
                             Cursor, Codex, etc.)
  help [command]             display help for command

Made by RIVI Software (https://rivi.software). Docs and issues: https://github.com/rivi-software/agentic-seo-check
